description:
What is This Part?
This is the Genuine Suzuki OEM Rear Engine Mount & Bracket. (Transmission Mount & Bracket)
Mounts Under the Transmission and Attaches it to the Frame.
A Worn Out or Broken Mount will Typically Cause a slight vibration and premature failure of associated parts such as U-Joint, Oil Seals Etc….
Includes Connecting Hardware!
Genuine Suzuki OEM Parts
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Mount, Rear Engine
Qty 1 – Bracket, Mount (Rear Engine)
Qty 1 – Bolt, Lock Washer
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
